people.name: Jesus

translations.web: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,
translations.bsb: From the descendants of this man, God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as He promised.
translations.kjv: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
